about: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 includes PS4 & PS5 versions.
Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.
Step into The Grounds‡‡, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium.
From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch.
